heroHeadline: Trump Sets Iran Deal Conditions on NBC 'Meet the Press': No Asset Unfreeze; Will Help Destroy Uranium — Day 504
heroSubtitle: On June 7, 2026 (Day 504 of Trump's second term / Day 99 of the US-Iran war), Trump appeared on NBC 'Meet the Press' laying out his clearest Iran deal framework yet: he will NOT unfreeze Iranian assets or offer early sanctions relief ('If they behave, if they do a good job, we start talking'), but WILL help Iran destroy its ~440.9 kg of 60%-enriched uranium stockpile if a deal is reached — reversing earlier 'entombed' framing. Iran's supreme leader adviser told CNN talks are 'at a deadlock.' The US shot down six Iranian drones near the Strait of Hormuz and struck radar stations on Goruk Island and Qeshm Island over the prior 48 hours; Iran accused the US of ceasefire violations. The Senate-passed $70 billion ICE/CBP reconciliation funding bill awaits a House floor vote the week of June 8 — passage before the recess window closes is essential; House Republicans canceled Friday votes (June 6) due to attendance concerns. Trump confirmed G7 attendance in Évian-les-Bains, France (June 15–17), where Iran diplomacy is expected to dominate the margins with Macron offering a post-summit Versailles dinner to secure Trump's participation. On June 6, a federal judge struck down a Trump immigration policy affecting 39 countries. On June 5 (Day 502), Trump demanded Iran put nuclear concessions in writing; the Senate blocked the SAVE America Act for a second time (Collins, McConnell, Murkowski, Tillis joined Democrats); Bolton agreed to plead guilty to retaining classified information ($2.25M restitution). Warsh's first FOMC meeting as Fed Chair: June 16–17. Oil at ~$88/bbl; 10yr yield ~4.47%; Trump approval at net -25% (The Economist/The Hill) — lowest of either term.
